component.name: OpenMarket
component.summary: Charts, indicators, orders and an agent for many markets in one window

description.p: This is a community package of OpenMarket for desktop, maintained independently. It repackages the official Linux AppImage unmodified, and is not affiliated with or supported by OpenMarket.

OpenMarket puts stocks, crypto, futures, options, forex and prediction markets on one live chart: candles, indicators, drawings, orders and an agent, layered in one window. The desktop app is in beta and needs an OpenMarket account.
Sign-in opens in your web browser and returns to the app when it is done.
Downloads are saved to your Downloads folder. The package has no other access to your files.
Updates come through Flatpak; the application's own update check does nothing in this package.
